descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S12 「现成的 spec：dashboard 背后的查询从不返回另一个医生的病人」 Existing specs: the queries behind the dashboard never return another physician's patients

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 With patients in a mix of pending / in-progress / complete states, the dashboard counts (Total, Pending, In Progress, Complete) match the real patient-list state, in Hospital and in Nursing Home（UAT TC-20；TFA-92598 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U2 The dashboard is present (reachable from the patient list) and correct in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-20；TFA-92598 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Demo physician and a second physician, each with patients whose names, MRNs and diagnoses match

When Page through listPage (the query the dashboard reads) and read listCounts in each care setting

Then The other physician's matching row is never returned. Totals move only with the owner's own adds and removes. In Nursing Home, 'today' counts only In Today rows

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright api assertions. Server level only: the dashboard screen is judged in S03, S04a/S04b and S13. Also evidence that the server already keeps an In Today count (listCounts.today) that the Nursing Home dashboard does not use

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S12 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-20.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
